semantics.chartPages: For each period and book, keep the maximum recorded page, then sum books.
semantics.pagesRead: For heatmap and daily activity, sum max(0, page - previous_page).
semantics.readingSeconds: Sum reading_sessions.duration_seconds by started_at in KST.
semantics.completedBooks: Count owned, non-deleted books where status=completed and updated_at belongs to the selected year.
semantics.genre: Count completed books by the first segment before >; empty values are Uncategorized.
semantics.goal: Read the owner-scoped reading_goals row and calculate progress from completed books in the selected year.

web.dailyTargetBoundary: Per-book daily targets and target dates are mutated by /api/consumer/progress with owner-scoped CAS; this route remains limited to annual reading goals.
web.aiBoundary: The server derives ownership from the authenticated session and delegates to the quota-gated reading-insights adapter. Quota and provider failures remain operational retry states and never become billing prompts.

nativeOnly.native-push: browser notification equivalent remains a separate capability
nativeOnly.camera: camera/OCR remains a separate browser capability
nativeOnly.share-sheet: Web Share API with clipboard/download fallback
nativeOnly.subscription: native RevenueCat billing remains disabled on Web

evidenceDisposition: Local fixtures prove contract and browser behavior only; they do not claim production provider parity.
